scope: Read-only review of all 43 compact custom-kit options; production geometry and old assertions unchanged.

requirements.G01: Native evidence and isolated additions-only checkpoint

findings.title: Roof lip floats above the roof without mounts
Arch extension returns remain detached from stock panels
Simplified Power dome and Vented dome accent patches intersect the hood

measurement_limits: Unscaled model metres; sampled vertical/lateral clearances, not continuous minimum Euclidean distances.
Arch numbers cover positive side at Y>=0.385; absent stock ray hits are excluded and counted.
Detailed insert clearances are positive; the confirmed insert intersections concern simplified meshes.
Successful diagnostic exit means execution, not absence of findings.

legacy_workflow_failures.status: Preserved; current parts-focus behavior is separately validated. No existing assertion changed.

unsuccessful_attempts: Initial sandbox construction run failed certificate-store access. Its uncorrected wrapper falsely recorded exit zero; log is retained and that result is invalid.
Initial and second arch diagnostics selected only left stock nodes through repeated labels. Their approximately 1.77 metre gaps are invalid; final measurements select mesh identities.
Pillow imports failed in the first Python contact-sheet helper and Python39 probe. No packages installed; final sheets use Windows System.Drawing.

concurrent_source_changes.disposition: Concurrent rear-drive launch-slip steering fade; unrelated to prepared kit joins. No claim that physics regressions cover this later edit.

remaining_acceptance: Correct the three model findings in separate authorized work.
Owner/device visual, motion and cost acceptance.
